title: Page one
logline: Tuesday. After 'Of what.' Gully picks up page one. Reads the first line. Puts it down. Says it's good. Wood asks which part. Gully says the part where it stops.

panels.composition: The garage floor, still covered. GULLY crouching, picking up a page. WOOD frozen. BARNABY on page 300.
